title: Add a lab stage
summary: Add a stage to the circuit (for example, “Try-in”), with its type and overdue days.

steps.title: Menu → Business Setup → Lab Stages
steps.details: The stages every lab order goes through, in order.

steps.title: Add stage
steps.details: It is added as intermediate, before the final stages.

steps.title: Name
steps.details: Written by the clinic; it is not translated.

steps.title: Type
steps.details: Intermediate: one more step in the circuit. Final: the order ends there (Completed, Cancelled) and stops being pending. Marking another as initial replaces the current one.

steps.title: Overdue days
steps.details: More days than this in the stage and the order turns red. Empty: no limit. Final stages have none.

steps.title: Place it in the circuit
steps.details: Drag it by the left handle into place. The bell sets up its alerts.

steps.title: Save
steps.details: The board gets the new column in the chosen order.
